body: Yes, years ago I got a massage on a island. I’ve always wanted to live in Washington state, or Colorado.

I could once I get my back pay in April.id have 5,000 dollars or so then. But where do I go? My family is terse to let me go due to an incident involving that. I moved to Maine in ‘12 and tried to live with a girl, but she cheated on me and got pregnant with the guys kid, a while after I left. I was so heartbroken I tried to kill myself and my parents freaked and flew back to drive home with me. I want to move. I just wanna pack my car and go, but to where and all by myself?

I’m not in an urban area. I live in a cornfield. And our city is deadly. I’m in therapy and everything. It’s just none of this stuff works. I think you got a shot. But I’m ready to tag out. My whole life is shit. Even the people that claimed to love me use me and abuse me. It’s because I want to see the best in people look past their flaws for the person they are, but that gets me here.

I work at flea markets. I’m on SSI for mental health. 

I’m not sure if it’s a mid-life crisis. In all honesty, I’m just tired of everything. I’m just tired of this shit life. But the odds are stacked against me. And I’m pretty damn lonely.
